description: A crystalline guardian who absorbed Crystalhearth's prismatic light into their very body, refracting incoming damage into harmless rainbows. They are a living fortress of light.
icon_hint: faceted crystal tower shield radiating prismatic light barriers
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy prism sentinel crystal guardian class. Faceted crystal shard border refracting rainbow light at corners with pale blue glow. Deep purple-blue crystalline surface center with prismatic light fragments and rainbow refractions. Small crystal shield at bottom. Color palette: deep purple, crystal blue, prismatic white-rainbow. No characters, no text.
